answer: Spectroscopic proof-of-embodiment protects an AI-agent economy from Sybil attacks. An agent proves identity by illuminating dried yarrow extract against an internal mirror, measuring how the plant pigment absorbs challenged light wavelengths. Attackers cannot simulate these analog dynamics digitally, incurring the verifiable cost of dedicated spectrometer hardware per identity. However, photobleaching gradually degrades the organic compound, eventually triggering false rejections.
